title.rendered: Rhapsody of Realities: Let’s Reach The World For Christ

content.rendered:
Go ye therefore, and teach all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen (Matthew 28:19-20).

There’s no higher mandate than the one given to us by Jesus Christ to take the Gospel to every man’s world. He has commanded us to go and speak and act in His

Name. What an honour! We’re His ambassadors, to make students of the nations, to show them how to live. When He said, “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,” he didn’t just mean countries. The word, “nation” is “ethnos” which means a group of people that share common interests.

Those in your “ethnos” or nation are people with whom you share a common interest, perhaps, through your job, business, or even language. If you’re a schoolteacher for example, your fellow teachers are those in your world whom you must win to Christ. If you’re a politician, be God’s voice to other politicians and win them to Christ. Be an effective witness in your world.

This is a mandate for every believer, not just for pastors, prophets, and evangelists. Jesus said, “Go, and make disciples of all nations….” These were His parting words, His

final commandment to the Church; we must take it seriously. Have the inner motivation, the burning passion, to make the Gospel known, and get everyone in your world ready for the Master’s soon return. You might be the last or only hope they

have to hear and receive the Gospel. Take advantage of every opportunity to win souls, and together, let’s reach the world for Christ!

 

PRAYER

Dear Father, I thank you for having ordained me to preach the unsearchable riches of Christ. I recognize that I’ve been charged with the responsibility to minister life, and the power of God to the lost and hurting in this world. The light of the glorious Gospel shines intensely in their hearts, destroying the shackles of darkness. Many are snatched from the thraldom of darkness into your glorious kingdom, in Jesus’ Name. Amen.
